A '''Sullustan clerk''' worked at the [[Spaceport Hotel]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Despite the price of rooms being set at ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the clerk would always attempt to haggle with the customers for more money.<ref name="TM" />
